page_title: BOU 2-2 LEE | Bournemouth v Leeds 22/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Michael Salisbury is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' 2 - 2 What a hit! Sean Longstaff (Leeds) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. 2:2.
90+5' Evanilson (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

90+3' Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom right corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Djordje Petrovic, who gets down to save.
90+3' Celebrations are cut short for Bournemouth as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+2' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Bournemouth players aren’t happy.

90+1' Goal! Evanilson (Bournemouth) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Karl Darlow had no chance of reaching it. The score is 3:1.
90+1' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Marcus Tavernier is replaced by Alex Toth (Bournemouth).
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The attendance for today's match is 11226.
89' A substitution has been made. Ao Tanaka is replaced by Joel Piroe (Leeds).
89' CHANCE! Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the crossbar!
88' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) will take a corner kick.
85' The corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence.

85' 2 - 1 Wonderful movement! Tyler Adams is in a good position inside the box but decides to pass the ball to Rayan (Bournemouth), who keeps his cool and blasts the ball inside the left post. What a finish that is – 2:1.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Brenden Aaronson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sean Longstaff (Leeds).
81' Evanilson (Bournemouth) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
81' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
80' Rayan (Bournemouth) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
78' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Karl Darlow makes a save.

76' A dangerous towering header by James Hill (Bournemouth) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
76' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
75' Rayan (Bournemouth) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked. Bournemouth have a corner.
73' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Amine Adli (Bournemouth) replaces Ryan Christie.
73' It's time for a substitution. Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) comes on in place of Eli Junior Kroupi.
72' Leeds failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
72' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds). The ball goes out of play. Leeds are awarded a corner kick.
71' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) commits a rough foul. Michael Salisbury stops the game and makes a call.
68' 1 - 1 Own goal! James Hill (Bournemouth) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 1:1.
68' Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Rayan (Bournemouth) is replacing David Brooks.
65' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
64' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) replacing Jaka Bijol.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Noah Okafor as he is replaced by Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds).
63' Noah Okafor (Leeds) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the left post.

60' 1 - 0 Goal! Marcos Senesi plays in Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the top of the net! Great finish - 1:0.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.

60' A lofted cross from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a chance to score from a corner.
59' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes.
56' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends a chip pass into the box, but Karl Darlow is quickest to intercept the ball.
54' David Brooks (Bournemouth) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
54' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Salisbury has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
51' David Brooks (Bournemouth) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
51' Evanilson (Bournemouth) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
50' Noah Okafor (Leeds) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' What a miskick by Alex Scott (Bournemouth). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
49' The resulting corner from David Brooks (Bournemouth) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

48' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle after Joe Rodon (Leeds) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Bournemouth will take a free kick near the side line.
47' Noah Okafor (Leeds) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Daniel Farke probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Jayden Bogle. He is replaced by Joe Rodon (Leeds).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' Chance! Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit. Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) is penalised for a foul. Michael Salisbury had a clear view and blows his whistle.
44' A quickly taken corner by Bournemouth.

43' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Karl Darlow. Evanilson (Bournemouth) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Now Bournemouth have a corner.

42' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
42' It seems like Ao Tanaka (Leeds) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
41' What was Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
41' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Michael Salisbury signals. Leeds win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
38' The foul by Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) was seen by Michael Salisbury who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

37' Ao Tanaka (Leeds) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic made an astonishing save!
37' The corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is cleared away by the defence.
36' 4:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 1:0.
34' David Brooks (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.

32' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it low towards the middle of the target, but Karl Darlow pulled off a nice save and to stop the attempt.
30' Noah Okafor (Leeds) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
29' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
29' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
27' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
25' Yellow card. Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.

24' The ball is cleared after Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for an infringement.
23' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
22' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Evanilson (Bournemouth). Michael Salisbury saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
20' Noah Okafor (Leeds) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
17' James Hill (Bournemouth) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
16' David Brooks (Bournemouth) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
16' Evanilson (Bournemouth) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort. Bournemouth earn a corner.
16' David Brooks (Bournemouth) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

16' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
12' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) commits a foul and Michael Salisbury immediately signals a free kick.

11' Good chance for Evanilson (Bournemouth) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
8' David Brooks (Bournemouth) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
7' Bournemouth play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
5' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
3' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
3' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

1' Noah Okafor (Leeds) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
